# Omar Sherif

> Computer Science student at Ahram Canadian University (ACU) specializing in systems, IT infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and Notion ecosystems. Notion Campus Leader and founder/manager of an 11,000+ member Notion community.

## Overview
Omar Sherif (online handle: `om4rss`, `om4r`) is a systems engineer, developer, and Notion systems architect based in Cairo, Egypt. He studies Computer Science at Ahram Canadian University and focuses on low-level systems, Active Directory infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and productivity architecture.

## Key Technical Focus Areas
- **Systems & Infrastructure**: Linux (Fedora), Windows Server / Active Directory (AD DS), Docker, networking devices and protocols.
- **Cybersecurity**: Endpoint security, network defense, threat fundamentals (certified by Cisco Academy).
- **Programming Languages**: C, C++, Python.
- **Hardware & IoT**: ESP32 microcontroller systems, robotics, IoT telemetry.
- **Productivity & Workspace Architecture**: Advanced Notion database architecture, formula modeling, workflow automation.
- **Creative Suite**: Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, DaVinci Resolve, Figma, Blender.

## Key Projects
- [Minimal Second Brain](https://www.notion.so/marketplace/templates/msb): Flagship interconnected Notion system for organizing personal projects, knowledge, and tasks.
- [Simple Habit Tracker](https://www.notion.com/templates/simplehabits): Minimalist habit tracking system with progress metrics.
- [Academic OS](https://app.notion.com/templates/academicos): Comprehensive Notion workspace for university students to track courses, assignments, and exam schedules.
- [Voice-Controlled ESP32 Robot](https://github.com/om4rss/esp32nexusr1): 2WD robotic car built with ESP32, L298N driver, and a Python server integrating the Gemini API for natural voice processing.
- [Caffeine](https://github.com/om4rss/caffeine): Lightweight native Windows C++ utility preventing computer sleep during long tasks and downloads.
